dedupe_keys.name: iea ebc annex 58 twin houses whole model empirical validation dataset

description: This dataset supports an empirical validation study of building energy simulation on two identical full-size test houses, carried out within IEA Energy in Buildings and Communities Annex 58. It was deposited on Taylor and Francis figshare in November 2015 by Paul Strachan, Katalin Svehla, Ingo Heusler and Matthias Kersken with their journal paper. It gives the experimental configuration, monitoring details and measured data from a two-month side-by-side experiment on houses with high thermal mass in a period of high solar gains, with predictions from 21 modelling teams using commercial and research programs. Coverage: two test houses; the site is not named in the record. Access: 92 MB on figshare. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the record found that user input errors caused poor agreement for several programs, especially in the blind phase. Simulation uses: testing and validating building energy simulation programs and calibration workflows. Related records: the Fused Twin Base and TWINS facade validation datasets.
